exposure: complete placenta previa vs. incomplete placenta previa
finding: Complete placenta previa is associated with increased risk of hemorrhage, more invasive interventions (general anesthesia, blood transfusions, cesarean hysterectomy), and more postoperative complications compared with incomplete placenta previa.
mod_finding: Women with complete placenta previa had a higher incidence of general anesthesia during delivery compared to women with incomplete placenta previa.
